text:
Talia Benson: Standard Demo v1 is live :tada: 

This is the new “single source of truth” demo (tenant + scenarios + deck + talk track + runbook) so we can stop reinventing the wheel per call.

Where to find everything:
• Confluence (canonical): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Standard+Demo+v1
• Deck (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwi-redwood-standard-demo-v1
• Talk track (Speaker notes): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwi-redwood-standard-demo-v1/talk-track
• Demo tenant setup + reset runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENG/Demo+Tenant+Setup+Runbook
• Known-good scenario matrix (what to run + expected outputs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwi-redwood-standard-demo-v1/scenarios

Request updates / report issues:
• #demo-tenant channel for fast triage
• File a ticket using the template: https://linear.app/redwoodinference/new?template=demo-v1

Please don’t fork the deck in random personal drives—use the “Make a copy” flow and keep edits in the working doc if you want changes upstream.

Markus Klein: +1. Also: demo tenant name is `demo-std-v1` in Console. Access is via SSO group `GTM-Demo-Tenant`. If you can’t see it, DM me + your Okta email (or file an access request).

Soojin Lee: Deck is finalized as “Standard Demo Deck v1” (no pricing numbers on slides). If you need to add a slide for a specific customer, please do it as an appendix in your copy and send us a screenshot / rationale for upstream.

Renee Sullivan: Scenarios included in v1 (all tested this week):
1) 2-min Hosted API mini-demo (streaming chat)
2) Tool calling + structured output (deterministic inputs)
3) Routing + fallback (capacity tier + model variant)
4) Console observability (latency + token cost breakdown + errors)
5) Cost controls (batching/caching toggle + before/after)

If you want a 15-min version: run 1 + 3 + 4.

Elliot Price: Docs stub is up (internal-only) with the links above + the “don’t say this in front of a prospect” footnotes: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/internal/demo-environment

Rafael Mendes: Ops note: please run the pre-demo checklist before *any* exec/prospect call. It’s 60–90 seconds and saves pain.
Checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwi-redwood-standard-demo-v1/reset-checklist

Logan Wright: Dashboards are preloaded in the tenant under “Demo v1 - Overview” + “Demo v1 - Errors”. If they look empty, refresh the time window to last 15m (default is 24h right now).

Stephanie Nguyen: This is awesome. For NA teams: we’ll standardize on this for all first-call technical demos starting next week. SE managers—please make sure everyone attends one dry run.

Lukas Meyer: EMEA ask: do we have a clean “data residency / EU region” branch in the talk track? We keep getting that question early.

Soojin Lee: Yep. Talk track has an EMEA branch at ~minute 9 (“Private + regional routing”). It’s in the doc sidebar as “If asked: EU-only / residency”. We’re also adding a 1-slide appendix for EU region availability (wording approved by Legal).

Camila Reyes: Marketing note: benchmark proof points are now in the deck as ranges only. Please don’t quote absolute ms/token numbers unless it’s in the “safe ranges” table. If you need something specific, ping #pmm.

Naomi Feldman: Security FAQ is linked in the Confluence hub. Please use that wording for retention/audit log questions (and don’t improvise). If a prospect asks for SOC2 letter / pen test, route to Security questionnaire flow.

Isabelle Laurent: For CRM workflow: use the demo tenant for discovery + first technical validation. If they want hands-on, convert to a prospect trial *after* the demo and track it as “Demo → Eval” in HubSpot. Guidance here: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/REVOPS/Demo-to-Eval

Markus Klein: One more thing: if the model output varies slightly during the live run, don’t fight it. Narrate it (“nondeterminism is normal; we pin versions + add guardrails”). The scenarios have expected output *shape* + fallback clips.

redwood-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder: Weekly demo dry run is scheduled for Thu 10:00–10:45 PT. Calendar: “Standard Demo v1 Dry Run”. Join link in invite.

Renee Sullivan: If anyone wants to practice solo, the quickstart scripts are in the folder under `scripts/` (curl + python). Start here: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-quickstarts/tree/main/sales-demo

Rafael Mendes: And if anything is “slow today” please post in #demo-tenant with the dashboard link + region. Don’t just retry a bunch live (we’ve seen that trigger throttles).

Stephanie Nguyen: :thumbsup: Can we pin this thread for the week?

Talia Benson: Done. Also collecting feedback via this form (2 min): https://forms.gle/redwood-demo-v1-feedback — we’ll roll fixes into v1.1 and keep the deck stable week-to-week.

Lukas Meyer: Perfect, thanks. I’ll run the EU branch in tomorrow’s call and report back in the form.
